## The lost plants of the W̱SÁNEĆ/Saanich Peninsula

The gallery shows `<span class="saanich-lost-count">@{count}</span>`{=html} native species once reported for the Saanich Peninsula, which have not been seen in recent decades. Some may be lost *to us*—overlooked, forgotten, or waiting to be rediscovered. Others may be lost *because of us*, through impacts like habitat change or the introduction of invasive species.

<span class="saanich-callout">Pick a plant from the gallery</span> to see where and when it was last found, then join local naturalists and community members on a search for the
[“Lost” Plants of the Saanich Peninsula](https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/lost-plants-of-the-saanich-peninsula)
project on iNaturalist.

Szczawinski and Harrison’s (1972) *Flora of the Saanich Peninsula* provides the historical baseline for this atlas. Harvey Janszen devoted
much of his life to revising this flora, but passed away in 2021, before completing this work. A community of naturalists has
since carried those efforts forward; this atlas is a testament to that continuing legacy.
